say:0:1660213001:2.text: You tumble through the sky, free-falling with Ludovic and Soren—
say:0:1660213001:2.source_cn: 你与柳博米尔与索恩一起从高空坠落、坠落——
say:0:1660213001:2.male: You tumble through the sky, free-falling with Ludovic and Soren—
say:0:1660213001:2.female: You tumble through the sky, free-falling with Ludovic and Soren—

say:1:1660213002:1.text: —until a thick bed of golden leaves catches you in a soft embrace.
say:1:1660213002:1.source_cn: 直至厚重金黄的落叶堆稳稳接住了你们。
say:1:1660213002:1.male: —until a thick bed of golden leaves catches you in a soft embrace.
say:1:1660213002:1.female: —until a thick bed of golden leaves catches you in a soft embrace.

say:4:1660213004:0.text: Did I... hit you just now?
say:4:1660213004:0.male: Did I... hit you just now?
say:4:1660213004:0.female: Did I... hit you just now?

choice_prompt:5:1660213004.text: Did I... hit you just now?
choice_prompt:5:1660213004.male: Did I... hit you just now?
choice_prompt:5:1660213004.female: Did I... hit you just now?

say:7:1660213005:1.text: The dream twisted your thoughts. That curse from the Summer Tribe—it stokes rage and burns reason away.
say:7:1660213005:1.source_cn: 你被梦境里的诅咒所影响，愤怒、暴躁，充满攻击性。夏日诅...

say:8:1660213006:1.text: No wonder the whole tribe acted like they had a fire raging inside.
say:8:1660213006:1.source_cn: 难怪，部落的人，心里就像有一把火在烧。

say:9:1660213007:1.text: Suddenly, Soren's ears twitch. He turns toward a nearby heap of leaves.
say:9:1660213007:1.source_cn: 突然，索恩的耳朵动了动，他看向旁边的落叶堆。

say:12:1660213009:0.text: Soren's words had just faded when barking exploded from the depths of the forest, chased by the snap of boots crushing dead branches and leaves. Someone's running for their life.
say:12:1660213009:0.source_cn: 索恩话音刚落，自丛林深处传出了阵阵狗吠，还有脚步踩碎枯...

say:13:1660213010:0.text: A boy stumbles into view, lugging an oversized pack. Hot on his heels, two men in hunting gear barrel after him.
say:13:1660213010:0.source_cn: 你们看到一个背着高大箱子的小男孩儿先冲到了你们面前，他...
say:13:1660213010:0.male: A boy stumbles into view, lugging an oversized pack. Hot on his heels, two men in hunting gear barrel after him.
say:13:1660213010:0.female: A boy stumbles into view, lugging an oversized pack. Hot on his heels, two men in hunting gear barrel after him.

say:15:1660213011:0.text: This is the end of the line, brat!

say:17:1660213012:0.text: Hand over <style="highlight">whatever treasure your old man stashed</style>, and maybe I'll let you limp away!
say:17:1660213012:0.source_cn: 你如果愿意交出<style=highlight>你父亲...

say:18:1660213013:0.text: I told you, there is no treasure!
say:18:1660213013:0.source_cn: 我说了，根本没有什么宝贝！

say:19:1660213014:0.text: Lies! The <style="highlight">autumn curse</style> has rotted your wretched soul! Nothing true ever comes out of that mouth!

say:21:1660213015:0.text: Whoa there, hey! Can we all just cool it a second?!
say:21:1660213015:0.source_cn: 嘿，老、老兄！你们冷静点儿！

say:22:1660213016:0.text: Don't you see the backup we've got here?
say:22:1660213016:0.source_cn: 刚才是你们人多势众，现在是我们人更多了！

choice_prompt:23:1660213016.text: Don't you see the backup we've got here?
choice_prompt:23:1660213016.source_cn: 刚才是你们人多势众，现在是我们人更多了！

say:24:1660213017:0.text: Come on, my friend, don't say that! We go way back, don't we?
say:24:1660213017:0.male: Come on, my friend, don't say that! We go way back, don't we?
say:24:1660213017:0.female: Come on, my friend, don't say that! We go way back, don't we?

say:25:1660213018:1.text: Rowan freezes. He looks like he's about to say something, but Odie gives him a glare, and he swallows it.
say:25:1660213018:1.source_cn: 你看到罗万愣了一下，似乎想说什么。阿德对罗万使了个眼色...
say:25:1660213018:1.male: Rowan freezes. He looks like he's about to say something, but Odie gives him a glare, and he swallows it.
say:25:1660213018:1.female: Rowan freezes. He looks like he's about to say something, but Odie gives him a glare, and he swallows it.

say:26:1660213019:0.text: You're with them? You're helping these thieves?
say:26:1660213019:0.male: You're with them? You're helping these thieves?
say:26:1660213019:0.female: You're with them? You're helping these thieves?

say:28:1660213020:0.text: Perhaps someone could explain what this "autumn curse" is about?
say:28:1660213020:0.source_cn: 或许有人愿意告诉我们，什么是秋日诅咒？

say:29:1660213021:1.text: Ahh, you must be new around here! No wonder you haven't heard!
say:29:1660213021:1.source_cn: 哦我的朋友，你刚来秋之国，难怪不知道！

say:31:1660213022:0.text: The autumn curse rots the soul. It turns folks into cunning liars who'll trick you out of everything you own.
say:31:1660213022:0.source_cn: 秋日诅咒是一些被邪恶力量腐蚀了心肝的人，他们会不择手段...

say:32:1660213023:0.text: My father lost everything to someone cursed like that...
say:32:1660213023:0.source_cn: 我的父亲也被一个得了秋日诅咒的人骗走了一切……

say:34:1660213024:0.text: Your father was one of them! That snake stole a fortune from me!
say:34:1660213024:0.source_cn: 你的父亲也是个该死的受诅者，他骗了我一大笔钱！

say:35:1660213025:0.text: I... I can earn it back, I swear! I'll repay every coin!
say:35:1660213025:0.source_cn: 我、我能赚钱！我之后会还给你的！

say:36:1660213026:0.text: Back then, you had the Autumn Guild behind you. You could wave a candy stick and folks would trade you rubies! But now, you've got nothing!
say:36:1660213026:0.source_cn: 过去你背后靠着秋之国商会，你就是拿兜里的糖果出来，都有...

say:37:1660213027:0.text: Now hold on, fellas! These folks are Master Rowan's friends. Real capable types. If I were you, I'd be backing off real quick!
say:37:1660213027:0.source_cn: 哎呀，老兄们，这几位可是罗万少爷的朋友，个顶个的好手，...

say:38:1660213028:0.text: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!
say:38:1660213028:0.source_cn: 要是不乖乖调头回去，哼哼……等到我们这位朋友出手，恐怕...
say:38:1660213028:0.male: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!
say:38:1660213028:0.female: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!

choice_prompt:39:1660213028.text: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!
choice_prompt:39:1660213028.source_cn: 要是不乖乖调头回去，哼哼……等到我们这位朋友出手，恐怕你们就走不了了！
choice_prompt:39:1660213028.male: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!
choice_prompt:39:1660213028.female: And if you don't start walking? Well... once our friend here starts casting, you'll be leaving in a puff of smoke, if you're lucky!

say:40:1660213029:0.text: Come on now, Magister, look at the situation! We need you!
say:40:1660213029:0.male: Come on now, Magister, look at the situation! We need you!
say:40:1660213029:0.female: Come on now, Magister, look at the situation! We need you!

say:41:1660213031:0.text: Odie, I told you to keep quiet! This is a family matter. Don't drag strangers into it!
say:41:1660213031:0.source_cn: 阿德，都让你别信口雌黄，这是我们家的事情，不能把无辜的...

say:42:1660213032:1.text: Sir... sorry, young master... I'm just trying to keep us alive. We can make more coin, but we can't grow a new head.
say:42:1660213032:1.source_cn: 老爷，啊不，少爷啊，我这也是为了能让咱们活命嘛。钱可以...

say:44:1660213033:0.text: You two, they're con artists! I swear they're lying through their teeth!
say:44:1660213033:0.source_cn: 老板，他们两个是骗子，一定在撒谎！

say:45:1660213034:1.text: Hearing that, Odie reluctantly raises his blowgun.
say:45:1660213034:1.source_cn: 阿德闻言，只能拿起了吹箭。

say:46:1660213035:1.text: Aww, shoot... guess the jig is up.
say:46:1660213035:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，看来是瞒不过去了……

say:47:1660213036:1.text: Cursed rats! I knew you were conning us!
say:47:1660213036:1.source_cn: 该死的诅咒者，你们果然在骗人！

choice:39:0:1.text: Just so we're clear, I'm not on fireball duty.
choice:39:0:1.male: Just so we're clear, I'm not on fireball duty.
choice:39:0:1.female: Just so we're clear, I'm not on fireball duty.

say:50:1660213030:1.text: Of course I do! Odie, at your service! Helped you find the path to the realm of winter, remember?
say:50:1660213030:1.male: Of course I do! Odie, at your service! Helped you find the path to the realm of winter, remember?
say:50:1660213030:1.female: Of course I do! Odie, at your service! Helped you find the path to the realm of winter, remember?

choice:39:1:2.text: You actually remember who I am?
choice:39:1:2.male: You actually remember who I am?
choice:39:1:2.female: You actually remember who I am?

choice:23:0:1.text: Backup? Me? I don't even know you.
choice:23:0:1.male: Backup? Me? I don't even know you.
choice:23:0:1.female: Backup? Me? I don't even know you.

choice:23:1:2.text: Yeah! You better step back, man.
choice:23:1:2.male: Yeah! You better step back, man.
choice:23:1:2.female: Yeah! You better step back, man.

choice:5:0:1.text: You did. It stung, by the way.
choice:5:0:1.male: You did. It stung, by the way.
choice:5:0:1.female: You did. It stung, by the way.
